scenario: An e-commerce subscription platform's customer success team reviews a cohort of at-risk subscribers, scores their churn risk, designs personalised retention offers for each risk tier, and calculates the financial value of the proposed discounts to decide which offers to approve.
info_flow: customer-success-manager scores each subscriber's churn risk and assigns a tier (Critical/High/Medium/Low) → customer-retention reads the tier labels and recommends a retention strategy including a discount percentage → financial-calculator computes the discounted price and total savings from the recommended percentage applied to the subscriber's monthly plan value.
